normal.title: Normal Motor Operation
symptoms: Temperature, vibration, and current are within normal limits.

overheating.title: Motor Overheating
symptoms: Motor temperature exceeds the configured safe threshold.
recommended_actions: Inspect ventilation openings and cooling arrangements.
Check whether the motor is operating under excessive load.
Request technician inspection if overheating persists.

excessive_vibration.title: Excessive Motor Vibration
symptoms: Motor vibration exceeds the configured normal threshold.
recommended_actions: Inspect mounting and fasteners after the equipment is safely stopped.
Request a technician to inspect alignment and bearings.
Do not resume operation until required safety checks are complete.
